AgentCompass v0.6.6 sends follow-up work back to the worker that already holds its context and rotates workers far less often. It builds on v0.6.5.

- **Workers are replaced less often.** The default context rotation threshold (`rotate_after_carried_tokens`) rises from 2M to 4M carried tokens, and the tray's quota-saving preset from 1.5M to 3M. A study of one machine's dispatch history found no rise in tool errors up to six and more compactions, while a fresh worker spent a median of about 8 minutes and 150k tokens re-reading the project before its first edit. A value you set in the tray is kept.
- **`roll` continues an idle worker instead of starting a new one.** When the parent has an idle worker under the threshold that passes the gate checks (account enabled, quota not exhausted, no refusing window), `roll` resumes it for an explicit chain, the same brief, or the same `--workspace`. A read-only review still never resumes a worker that wrote code.
- **`--resume` no longer fails when the router would pick another model.** An explicit `--resume <id>` is the parent's continuation choice: the worker is resumed on its own bundle (reserved and quota-checked against that bundle) with a warning naming the router's pick. A worker that is busy, worn, gated or not the parent's is refused with a `blocked` result and a `next_action`, never silently replaced by a fresh worker.
- **A busy `--workspace` names the worker to resume.** When an idle worker of the same parent holds the directory, the refusal says `--resume <id>`.
- **The rules say the same.** The skill, the dispatch rules and the default global rule now say follow-up or related work goes back to the worker that holds its context, and a continuation verdict of `unknown` caused only by unavailable telemetry is not a reason to replace a worker. `agentcompass setup` (run by the update on a machine that was set up) rewrites the rule blocks. If you keep your own rule overlay, edit it yourself.

The Windows tray installer is unsigned; Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch. See [packaging/SIGNING.md](https://github.com/akiiwa-games/AgentCompass/blob/v0.6.6/packaging/SIGNING.md).

Status: alpha. Accounts come from discovery on your machine; choose which ones take part in the tray.
